---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — censoring diagnostics"
subtitle: "Reverse Kaplan–Meier curves and a frequentist censoring-hazard model"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

These diagnostics compare the unrestricted censoring distribution between
randomized groups. Censoring is treated as the event and death as a censored
observation. The Cox model is descriptive: it can identify differential
censoring hazards by randomized group, but cannot establish that censoring is
independent of prognosis.

```{r}
#| label: derive-supporting-os-unrestricted-censoring-diagnostics
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)

input_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here(
  "results", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-censoring"
)
figure_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-censoring", "figures"
)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

censoring_data <- arrow::read_parquet(input_path) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    tx,
    tx_plot = factor(
      tx,
      levels = 0:1,
      labels = c("Control", "Intervention")
    ),
    follow_up_days = survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    censoring_event = 1L - status_death_unrestricted
  )

reverse_km_fit <- ggsurvfit::survfit2(
  survival::Surv(follow_up_days, censoring_event) ~ tx_plot,
  data = censoring_data,
  conf.type = "log-log"
)
max_follow_up <- max(censoring_data$follow_up_days, na.rm = TRUE)
risk_times <- seq(0, max_follow_up, by = 100)

reverse_km_plot <- ggsurvfit::ggsurvfit(
  reverse_km_fit,
  linewidth = 0.8
) +
  ggsurvfit::add_confidence_interval(alpha = 0.16) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = risk_times) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max_follow_up), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Days since randomization",
    y = "Probability of remaining uncensored",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggsurvfit::add_risktable(
    times = risk_times,
    risktable_stats = c("n.risk", "cum.event"),
    stats_label = list(n.risk = "At risk", cum.event = "Events")
  )

censoring_cox_model <- survival::coxph(
  survival::Surv(follow_up_days, censoring_event) ~ tx,
  data = censoring_data,
  ties = "efron",
  x = TRUE,
  y = TRUE
)
log_hazard_ratio <- unname(stats::coef(censoring_cox_model)[["tx"]])
standard_error <- sqrt(stats::vcov(censoring_cox_model)["tx", "tx"])
cox_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  comparison = "Intervention versus control",
  hazard_ratio = exp(log_hazard_ratio),
  conf_low = exp(log_hazard_ratio - stats::qnorm(0.975) * standard_error),
  conf_high = exp(log_hazard_ratio + stats::qnorm(0.975) * standard_error),
  p_value = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(log_hazard_ratio / standard_error)),
  n_participants = nrow(censoring_data),
  n_censoring_events = sum(censoring_data$censoring_event)
)

proportional_hazards <- survival::cox.zph(
  censoring_cox_model,
  transform = "km"
)
proportional_hazards_summary <- as.data.frame(proportional_hazards$table) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

arrow::write_parquet(
  cox_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "censoring-cox-model.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  proportional_hazards_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "censoring-cox-ph-test.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "reverse-kaplan-meier.png"),
  ggsurvfit::ggsurvfit_build(reverse_km_plot),
  width = 8,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#| label: tbl-supporting-os-unrestricted-censoring-cox
#| tbl-cap: "Frequentist Cox model for the unrestricted censoring hazard"
#| echo: false

cox_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```

#| label: tbl-supporting-os-unrestricted-censoring-ph-test
#| tbl-cap: "Proportional-hazards test for the censoring model"
#| echo: false

proportional_hazards_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
